purpose: The keys heads_e2.py READS from the single fenced ```json g3-params block inside data/f5/G3_PREREGISTRATION.md. heads_e2.py holds no default for any of them: a missing key is a refusal. This file documents what G3 must pin for heads 2 and 3; it is not itself a parameter source and is never read at run time. Head 1's keys are documented in G3_PARAMS_SCHEMA.json; the four shared keys (fold_quarters, columns.confirmatory_text, columns.numeric, embedding.pca_k) appear in both by design.

guard.rule: data/f5/G3_RATIFIED.json must exist and its doc_sha256 must equal sha256(data/f5/G3_PREREGISTRATION.md)
guard.on_failure: FreezeRefusal; exit code 2; nothing is computed

block_format: Exactly one fenced block ```json g3-params ... ``` in the document; its parsed JSON object is the parameter root. Two such blocks is a refusal (parameters must have one unambiguous source). Parsed by backtest_e2.extract_params_block.

required_head2.meaning: which stratum's events are in scope; the confirmatory arm is core
column of data/f5/text_features_e2.parquet used as the predictor
pre-registered sign of the association; fixes the one-sided p
inclusive session offsets AFTER the news session for the DV numerator; the opening offset must be >= 1
number of daily returns in the DV denominator, ending at the pre-session
clustering unit for the wild bootstrap

required_head3.meaning: the HEAD-1 fold list, read from the same key head 1 reads; head 3 scores the same folds
exit horizon after the feature date, as 3-month offsets
last date on which an exit would have been observed; folds whose horizon closes after it are censored, not scored
which distress_events.event_kind values count as an exit
which filing in the quarter supplies the features

whether training rows whose exit horizon closes on or after the test quarter's start are purged. 'horizon_end_before_test_start' is the head-3 analogue of decision 5's label purge and is the ONLY implemented rule (as in head 1, one purge rule); a no-purge convention would train on rows whose labels resolve inside or after the test quarter and is a refusal here, not a selectable value. This module holds no default: the key is leakage-relevant and must be pinned explicitly
the confirmatory text block (decision 3), shared with head 1; embedding columns are named emb_pc* and their count must equal embedding.pca_k
the numeric baseline block, shared with head 1
how a missing feature is handled; imputation is computed on the training fold only
the primary seed recorded with the run

conditionally_required.meaning: number of pooled-embedding principal components; required when the confirmatory text block names any emb_pc* column
